calls.title: Quick review of Feature/ Reusable Table UI
calls.summary: The team discussed standardizing UI components to align with a new design system, confirming the switch to 8-pixel rounded corners and using Radix components. Updates were made to table headers and pagination, advocating for plain text project tags to reduce confusion. The search behavior was refined, limiting its scope to improve user experience, and visual details like truncated feature names with hover details were agreed upon. Status labels for drafts and changes were aligned for better clarity, and a phased rollout strategy was adopted for UI updates in key feature sets to ensure consistency during transitions.
calls.keywords: Radix, Table UI, Design System, Pagination, Project Tags, Draft Status

calls.title: Quick review of Feature/ Reusable Table UI
calls.summary: The team discussed standardizing the design system by implementing an 8-pixel rounded corner across components to enhance consistency. A new Radix-based table component will replace the Bootstrap version, supporting a unified design. Project tags will transition from badges to plain text to minimize visual clutter, with automatic color settings for tags. The main search will be streamlined to target name, ID, and description, while new readability features such as a truncated-middle display will improve the UI. The pagination component's position has been adjusted for better layout, and the 'Changes' column will be redesigned for clarity. The entire update strategy aims to ensure that changes are coherent and consistent through bundled pull requests.
calls.keywords: Rounded corners, Radix components, search functionality, project tags, pagination, table UI redesign
